paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eichah Rabbah 1:41; at 1:51 there, the name is Rabbi Biva Sangoriya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading’s epithet מרנניא (or מרנגיא) is transliterated without deciding whether the initial מ means “of” or is part of the name. The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text has Biva Merangaya at Eichah Rabbah 1:41 and Biva Sangoriya at 1:51.

The saved Midrash Rabbah -- TE chapter 1 text has רבי ביבא מרנגיא at 1:41 and רבי ביבא סנגוריא at 1:51, corresponding to Hyman’s supplied citations. Full Rabbi is locally explicit at those occurrences. The heading’s Bivi, its two supplied epithets, and the body’s Biva form remain distinct from the digital vocalization; the initial מ is not resolved as a place preposition or part of a name. Hyman juxtaposes these references; this does not establish an alias or a shared historical identity. The existing note remains verbatim. No other figures, scriptural interpretations, historical episodes or teachings from the two long digital paragraphs are imported, and no printed-pixel or correction-history claim is made.
